Actual Activity memory callback drops live combined index; explicit reload reconstructs active catalog, citations and saved assets; report PSS/heap, not OS OOM proof.
Use actual import/select/search/source-dialog controls offline; verify collection, source hash/date/rights/text; capture visible output.
